1.

The Victor-Prince Himself a company Leads onward to the glory, With the wondrous battle-cry: "Glory to God’s ascended Lamb!"

2.

He gave His blood to make peace for us, God in grace looks down upon us; Clouds may seem to spread abroad, Nothing changes Him there.

3.

When our foe reveals Our sins like a flood, Jesus Himself defends us, Points to His own blood.

4.

Oh, how secure a redeemed company Moves forward to the haven of peace! God in Christ preserves us, Life we have received in His name.

5.

Soon in the glory We shall sing a well-known song, New yet through all eternity: "Worthy is the Lamb, who once died!"
